text: According to the chapter, increasing the input scaling σ_in pushes reservoir neurons toward which regime?
choices: The purely linear regime, where tanh(a) ≈ a
The saturated, nonlinear regime of the tanh activation
A regime with larger spectral radius and longer memory
A regime with more reservoir neurons
explanation: Large σ_in makes the pre-activation |a| large, driving tanh toward ±1 (saturation) and activating nonlinearity. Small σ_in keeps neurons near the linear regime. Increasing σ_in actually reduces effective memory (ρ_eff ≈ ḡ(σ_in)·ρ), the opposite of option 2.
